config.description: Distilled student on dozken's architecture at hidden 128 (225,922 params) -- v023's exact recipe, with the DISTILLATION TERM REWEIGHTED towards the teacher's tail. Nothing else changes: same teacher, same hidden size, same loss elsewhere, same schedule, same seed.
config.hypothesis: The teacher term is currently weighted by the metric weight abs(clip(y)), which already favours large-abs(y) rows but does so only LINEARLY and only via the LABEL. The metric is extraordinarily tail-concentrated (measured: the top 0.5% of scored rows hold 11.8% of sum abs(y), the top 5% hold 69.6%), so if the teacher's advantage lives in its extremes then a term weighted by abs(clip(teacher)) should transfer MORE of it than a term weighted by abs(y). Prediction: a real gain over v023 on identical rows. The prior here is genuinely uncertain -- this could equally be a wash, because the metric is a correlation and reweighting between rows mostly re-weights WHICH correlation is estimated rather than improving any of them. A wash would be informative: it would say teacher weighting is saturated and the remaining gap to the leaderboard is not a loss-shaping problem at all.
config.change_vs_parent: Adds loss.distill_tail_gamma = 2.0 and nothing else. gamma=0 reproduces v023 bit-identically (verified: loss diff 0.00e+00, both with and without the distill term active), so this isolates the weighting and nothing else.
